structure.title: A wager becomes a timetable
structure.text: The departure turns a theoretical calculation into a sequence of connections that must actually be made.

structure.title: Interruptions along the route
structure.text: Local encounters, delays, and pursuit repeatedly change the meaning of staying on schedule. The chapters keep several travellers' knowledge unequal.

people.name: Phileas Fogg
people.text: A wealthy, punctual London gentleman who bets half his fortune that he can circle the globe in eighty days, and sets off the same evening.

people.name: Passepartout
people.text: A cheerful Frenchman hired as Fogg's valet because he wanted a quiet life, and who is promptly dragged around the world.

people.name: Fix
people.text: A Scotland Yard detective convinced Fogg is a bank robber on the run, who follows him from country to country waiting for an arrest warrant.

context.title: Connected transport
context.text: Railways and steamships promise reliable links across great distances. A missed connection can undo many successful stages.
context.takeaway: The network is only as useful as its connections.

context.title: A traveller's viewpoint
context.text: Places are often described through a European traveller's assumptions. The adventure's excitement need not make every generalisation reliable.

notice.text: Notice moments when helping costs time.
notice.why: The wager's purpose competes with obligations encountered en route.

notice.text: Compare Fogg's exterior with his choices.
notice.why: Restraint does not necessarily mean indifference.

opening: Phileas Fogg's life runs so precisely that a disagreement at his club can become a timetable. He wagers a fortune that he can circle the world in eighty days and departs with a servant who had been hoping for a quiet position. Trains, steamships, and carefully calculated connections promise to make the journey possible. Weather, suspicion, and other people's emergencies have no obligation to cooperate. Verne turns the shrinking distances of the modern world into a chase in which stopping to help someone can cost everything.
